## Implementation

- **`dump(rows)`** — validates `rows` is a list/tuple of list/tuple-of-`str` (raises `ValueError` otherwise, e.g. `[1]`, `[[None]]`, `[[b'x']]`). - **`load(text)`** — a small state-machine parser. Quoted fields may contain any character including `,`/`\n`/`\r`, with `""` decoded to `"`; unquoted fields break on `,`, CR or LF (lone CR/LF tolerated as line breaks, like stdlib CSV).
